auth_account_delete_cleanup_explanation: You are signed out as soon as deletion is accepted. Cleanup of the items below can still be pending, including copies shared with others or stored elsewhere. A deleted account cannot be restored.
auth_account_delete_cleanup_pending: You are signed out. Cleanup is still pending, including copies shared with others or stored elsewhere. This does not confirm complete erasure.
auth_account_delete_confirmation_error: Type the confirmation phrase shown above.
auth_account_delete_denied: This account cannot be deleted yet. Complete the items listed above. A requirement may still be unfinished, or permission may be missing. This message does not say which.
auth_account_delete_description: This permanently deletes your REZICS account, signs you out everywhere, and cannot be undone.
auth_account_delete_erased_collections: Your private, unlisted and deleted Collections.
auth_account_delete_erased_library: Your whole library: shelf entries, reading progress and history, copies and follows.
auth_account_delete_erased_profile: Your profile, name, handle and avatar.
auth_account_delete_finality: Deletion is final and cannot be undone.
auth_account_delete_no_automated_account: Before deletion, make sure this account does not operate any automated accounts.
auth_account_delete_no_pending_transfer: Before deletion, ensure that no transfer is pending.
auth_account_delete_not_last_owner: Before deletion, ensure that you are not the last owner of any organization.
auth_account_delete_ownership_navigation: Appoint another owner from the organization’s member management page in the website’s managed accounts settings.
auth_account_delete_prepare: If you do not want something to stay, make the Collection private or delete the post first.
auth_account_delete_prerequisites_descri: Finish these requirements before deletion. This list does not show whether you can delete the account.
auth_account_delete_prerequisites_headin: Before you can delete this account
auth_account_delete_privacy_contact: To get a copy of your data, before or after deletion, contact {contact}.
auth_account_delete_retained_attribution: These stay attributed to “Deleted account”. No one can edit them, and no replacement curator is assigned.
auth_account_delete_retained_collections: Your public Collections as they are now, with their current notes.
auth_account_delete_security_description: This permanently deletes your REZICS account and signs you out everywhere.
auth_account_delete_unavailable: Account deletion is unavailable right now.
auth_account_operation_failure: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
auth_account_operation_leave_notice: Leaving does not undo a request already sent or resolve an unknown result. Return to this request and review its result before starting another.
auth_account_operation_reconfirm: Your identity was verified. Review the request and confirm again. Returning here does not carry out the action.
auth_account_operation_sign_in_required: You are signed out. Sign in to manage your account.
auth_account_operation_unavailable: A required service is unavailable. No success is confirmed. Retry later.
auth_account_operation_unknown: The result is unknown. The request may have taken effect. Retry the same request; do not start a duplicate. Being signed out does not confirm deletion.
auth_consent_approved: Access approved. You can return to the application.
auth_consent_approved_none: No permissions were added. Existing access remains unchanged.
auth_consent_declined: Access declined. This sends no approval.
auth_consent_declined_after_submission: Access declined. An earlier approval may still have taken effect.
auth_consent_scope_offline_access: Keep access when you are away
auth_consent_sign_in_required: Sign in to review this request.
auth_consent_stale_review: The requested access or your current permissions changed. Review the update and decide again.
auth_consent_submission_unknown: The approval result for this account is unknown and may have taken effect. Checking permissions later will not resolve it.
auth_consent_unattributed_submission: An earlier submission for this application and request is still unresolved. It may have come from another account, and this review cannot tell who.
auth_failure_rate_limited: Too many requests. Please try again later.
auth_failure_retry_after: Too many requests. Please try again in {seconds} seconds.
auth_failure_unavailable: Sign-in and recovery are temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
auth_home_intro: Find a task, see what to prepare, and open its review page.
auth_home_identity_ready: This is the account from the latest check.
auth_home_identity_missing_email: No email address is available for this account.
auth_home_identity_denied: Access to private account details was refused. Those details are hidden.
auth_home_identity_unavailable: Account details are unavailable. Your sign-in status is unknown.
auth_home_settings_description: Each page checks its own requirements and may ask you to sign in. A link only opens a review. This page does not know whether the action is available.
auth_home_security_description: Review passwords, passkeys and sessions in Security. You may need to sign in again or verify before a change.
auth_home_rename_description: Prepare the handle you want. The rename page checks the requirements and asks you to review and confirm.
auth_home_delete_description: This change is destructive. Review the requirements and consequences before you confirm. An accepted request does not mean every retained record or copy has been erased.
auth_home_signed_out_description: Sign in, create an account, or recover access.
auth_connected_operation_acknowledged: The permission change was acknowledged. Review current permissions separately.
auth_connected_operation_dispatched: A permission change was sent, but the result is not confirmed. Sign in and review your current permissions. Doing so does not confirm the earlier change.
auth_connected_operation_refused: The permission change was refused. Review current permissions before deciding again.
auth_connected_operation_unknown: The result of the permission change is unknown. Sign in and review your current permissions separately. That does not confirm the earlier change.
auth_connected_operation_unsent: No permission change was sent. Review current permissions before deciding again.
auth_inventory_choose_removals: Remove permissions you no longer want this application to have. Cancel to discard this selection.
auth_inventory_client_disabled: This application is disabled. You are still responsible for it.
auth_inventory_clients_description: These applications are your responsibility. The permissions they register do not give you access.
auth_inventory_clients_empty: You do not own any applications.
auth_inventory_consents_description: These permissions let applications act for you. That does not mean you own the application.
auth_inventory_consents_empty: No applications appear on this page.
auth_inventory_denied: Access was refused. No change is confirmed.
auth_inventory_expired: This page has expired or your session changed. Reload the list.
auth_inventory_preflight: This list does not confirm that you can delete your account. Resolve application ownership and other responsibilities first. Deletion checks them again.
auth_inventory_reduce_confirm: Reduce permissions for {name}? The permissions listed below will be removed. This also signs you out of your sessions.
auth_inventory_reduced: Access was reduced and you were signed out of your sessions. Sign in again to see your current permissions.
auth_inventory_remove_confirm: Remove access for {name}? This also signs you out of your sessions.
auth_inventory_unavailable: This list is unavailable. Your responsibilities and permissions are unknown.
auth_inventory_unknown: The result is unknown. Sign in again and reload before making another change.
auth_locale_pending: Current language: {language}. Apply to change it without leaving this page.
auth_locale_temporary: Language changed for this page only. Your browser did not remember the choice.
auth_locale_unsupported: This language is unavailable. Choose one from the list.
auth_login_departure_description: What you entered will be cleared. Leaving cannot cancel a sign-in already sent.
auth_login_invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
auth_login_page_unavailable: Sign-in choices could not be loaded. Try again.
auth_login_passkey_browser_unsupported: Passkey sign-in is not supported by this browser. Use your password instead.
auth_login_passkey_method_unavailable: Passkey sign-in is unavailable here. Use your password instead.
auth_login_pending_passkey: Waiting for passkey sign-in. Finish or cancel the prompt before choosing another method.
auth_login_rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Please try again later.
auth_login_recovery_success: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.
auth_login_retry_after: Too many sign-in attempts. Please try again in {seconds} seconds.
auth_login_review_signed_out: You are now signed out. Choose a sign-in method to continue.
auth_login_reviewed: This is the current session. Continue with this account, or use a different one.
auth_login_switching: You are signing in with a different account.
auth_login_unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
auth_login_uncertain: Sign-in could not be confirmed. It may have completed. Check who is signed in before you continue. A matching account does not confirm this attempt.
auth_login_viewer_changed: The signed-in account has changed. Review this account before continuing.
auth_members_departure: Leave this unfinished membership change? Unsent input will be discarded.
auth_members_acknowledged: The change was received. The member list below is a separate current view and does not mean the change is finished.
auth_members_actions_unavailable: Actions are unavailable for this membership.
auth_members_inventory_unavailable: The member list is unavailable. Reload to try again.
auth_members_last_owner: This is the last owner. This role cannot be changed or removed.
auth_members_leave_unavailable: Leaving is unavailable for your current membership.
auth_members_authority: Membership, ownership, the remaining organization, and responsibility rules decide whether this change is allowed. Resource grants are separate.
auth_members_confirm_check: I confirm this exact organization, member, and change.
auth_members_conflict: Membership changed, or this change conflicts with responsibility rules. Reload before continuing.
auth_members_denied: You do not have permission for this request. This page does not grant permission.
auth_members_intro: Manage existing members of this organization.
auth_members_no_reservation: No reservation is available for this membership. Its role cannot be changed, and it cannot be removed.
auth_members_preparing: Membership is not ready yet. Reload the member list before continuing.
auth_members_recovery_review: Review current membership before seeing details or retrying this change. Nothing will be sent automatically.
auth_members_recovery_sign_in: Sign in as the person who started the change
auth_members_recovery_unavailable: Membership details are unavailable. The earlier result is still unknown.
auth_members_step_up: Sign in again as the original person, then review and submit the same change again.
auth_members_unavailable: Membership management is unavailable. No change is confirmed.
auth_members_unknown: The outcome is unknown. Keep this same change for retry. The member list alone does not show what happened.
auth_organization_conflict: The organization could not be created. The handle may be taken.
auth_organization_creation_checking: Checking whether you can create an organization. This check does not send a request.
auth_organization_creation_approving: Checking and approving your creation request. This does not confirm that an organization was created.
auth_organization_creation_sending: Your creation request was sent. Waiting for a response.
auth_organization_creation_unknown: The creation result is still unknown. The organization may have been created. Signing out or a later refusal does not resolve this attempt.
auth_organization_delete_accepted: Deletion was committed. Cleanup may still be pending, including shared and external copies. Complete erasure is not confirmed.
auth_organization_delete_changed: The account, organization or request changed. Review the current organization and confirm a new request.
auth_organization_delete_denied: Deletion was refused. Resolve ownership obligations, pending transfers, and operated accounts before confirming again.
auth_organization_delete_effect: Deletion permanently closes this organization and cannot be undone. Cleanup can remain pending, including shared and external copies.
auth_organization_delete_read_denied: This organization is missing or you cannot currently manage it. No private summary or deletion is available.
auth_organization_delete_remedies: Resolve the organization’s ownership obligations, pending transfers, and operated accounts first. Your permission and responsibility rules decide whether deletion is allowed.
auth_organization_delete_still_readable: The organization can still be viewed. The earlier deletion result is unknown. Do not start another deletion.
auth_organization_delete_unknown: The deletion result is unknown and may have taken effect. Check the current organization; do not start another deletion. A missing organization or lost access alone does not confirm deletion.
auth_organization_explanation: An organization has no sign-in of its own. Creating one requires your permission, and organization creation must be open. You may be asked to verify your identity.
auth_organization_handle_invalid: Use 3 to 64 characters: letters a–z, numbers, hyphens or underscores. Start and end with a letter or number.
auth_organization_departure_description: Your unsent review will be discarded.
auth_organization_delete_departure_descr: Your typed confirmation will be cleared if you leave.
auth_organization_not_open: This part of REZICS is not open yet.
auth_organization_refused: Creation was refused. Check your permission to create an organization and whether the handle is available.
auth_organization_return_acknowledged: This page received confirmation that the organization was created. That confirmation is separate from your session status. This creation will not be sent again.
auth_organization_return_unresumable: This creation is still unresolved and cannot be resumed safely. The original request no longer matches this account or the recovery data. Sign in with the account that started it, or review Security. No new creation was sent.
auth_passkey_denied: That passkey was not accepted. Try again or use your password.
auth_permission_description_account_dele: Request permanent deletion of an account where you have deletion permission. Existing deletion requirements still apply.
auth_permission_description_account_mana: Request account management actions, including credentials, sessions and operated accounts, where you have management permission.
auth_permission_description_account_read: Request account details, preferences and account-related records that you are allowed to read.
auth_permission_description_account_upda: Request changes to account profiles, handles and preferences where you have permission.
auth_permission_description_limits: These descriptions explain what is requested, not whether an application is trustworthy. Account permissions, resource permissions, and existing grants still limit access.
auth_permission_description_offline_acce: Let the application renew access without you being present, while its current authorization remains valid.
auth_permission_description_openid_detai: Let the application identify your REZICS account when you sign in.
auth_permission_description_organization: Request creation of an organization where creation is allowed.
auth_permission_description_subject_read: Request information about works and other catalogue subjects, within your current access.
auth_permission_description_unknown_deta: This page does not know what this permission allows. Check its exact identifier before deciding.
auth_recovery_start_unknown: The recovery request may have been accepted, but the result is unknown. This does not confirm that an account exists or that mail arrived. A later refusal does not resolve that earlier request.
auth_recovery_return_complete_unknown: The earlier password reset may have completed. The result is unknown. Signing in or checking status cannot confirm what that reset did.
auth_recovery_return_complete_acknowledg: The earlier password reset was accepted. Sign in to continue.
auth_recovery_return_credentials_cleared: The email, recovery token, and password were cleared. The original submission cannot be retried here. You can sign in, or deliberately request a new recovery link.
auth_recovery_return_advice: Recovery options are ready. They show what you can do now, not the result of earlier steps.
auth_recovery_resend_confirmation: This sends a new request. The earlier request may still complete; mail delivery is not confirmed.
auth_recovery_departure_description: Leaving clears this recovery information. A request already sent may still finish.
auth_recovery_link_invalid: This recovery link is invalid or has expired.
auth_recovery_password_invalid: Password must be between 8 and 128 characters.
auth_recovery_start_success: Your recovery request was accepted. This does not confirm mail delivery or a password change.
auth_recovery_unknown: The result is unknown. Your password may already have changed. Try again with the original submission, or restart recovery. A later invalid link does not prove the change failed.
auth_recovery_consequences: A completed reset ends your existing sessions. Sign in again with your new password.
auth_rename_confirm: I confirm changing this account’s handle to @{handle}.
auth_rename_departure_unsent: Your proposed handle and confirmation will be cleared if you leave.
auth_rename_departure_pending: This rename was sent. Leaving will not cancel it or confirm its outcome. You can stay to review the current account.
auth_rename_conflict: The current handle changed, the requested handle is unavailable, or the change was refused. The account has been reloaded. Review it and confirm again.
auth_rename_denied: This session cannot rename this account. This page does not grant permission.
auth_rename_description: Choose a new handle. Your account and its content keep the same identity.
auth_rename_forwarding: Your former handle forwards to this account for 30 days. After that it stays reserved for your account and cannot be given to anyone else.
auth_rename_management_auth_required: Continue to authentication to review this account. The current handle stays hidden until then.
auth_rename_management_returned: You can review this account. Check the current handle and confirm any change before submitting. Coming back here did not submit a rename.
auth_rename_invalid: Enter a different handle using 3–64 letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens, with a letter or number at each end. Spaces are not allowed.
auth_rename_reconfirm: Review this saved change and confirm it again. Coming back after confirming your identity does not submit the rename.
auth_rename_retry: Confirm and retry the original rename
auth_rename_signed_out: Sign in to rename your own account.
auth_rename_unavailable: Account renaming is unavailable. We could not confirm your account securely. Reload before trying again.
auth_rename_unknown: A rename was sent, but its outcome is still unknown. Reviewing the current account does not retry it.
auth_security_action_accepted: The action was accepted. This does not confirm your security settings.
auth_security_action_unknown: The result is unknown. Check your security settings before trying again.
auth_security_action_unverified: Your session is no longer authorized. The result has not been verified. Sign in to check your security settings.
auth_security_authority_changed: Your account or sign-in changed. Sign in again to see your security settings.
auth_security_departure_description: Leaving clears the private details on this page. A security change already in progress may still finish.
auth_security_passkey_add_failed: The passkey could not be added. Please try again.
auth_security_passkey_last_credential: You cannot remove your last way to sign in. Add a password or another passkey first.
auth_security_passkey_registration_revie: Your passkeys are shown below. The earlier registration is still unconfirmed. Review the list before continuing.
auth_security_passkey_registration_unkno: The registration could not be confirmed. Your passkey may already have been added. Check your passkeys before continuing.
auth_security_passkey_remove_confirmatio: Remove this passkey? You will no longer be able to sign in with it. This signs you out of all sessions.
auth_security_passkey_remove_failed: The passkey could not be removed. Please try again later.
auth_security_passkeys_description: Sign in with your fingerprint, face, screen lock or a security key instead of a password.
auth_security_passkeys_empty: You have not added a passkey yet.
auth_security_passkeys_failed: Your passkeys could not be loaded. Please try again later.
auth_security_password_approval_unknown: This step is unconfirmed. No password change is confirmed. The same request is kept on this page. Retry only this step while it is still allowed.
auth_security_password_apply_unknown: We could not confirm whether the password changed. The same request is kept on this page. Retry it only while it is still allowed. A refusal or signing out does not resolve this.
auth_security_password_return_stage: This step may have been interrupted. It does not mean your password changed.
auth_security_password_return_approval: Your request was received, but approval may have been interrupted. Approval does not change your password.
auth_security_password_return_apply: The earlier steps were accepted, but the password change may have been interrupted. Whether it changed is unknown.
auth_security_password_return_applied_af: A password change was confirmed. It does not resolve a different earlier attempt whose result is still unknown.
auth_security_password_return_readback: This page cannot show whether a password is set, and it cannot resolve an earlier password change whose result is unknown.
auth_security_password_return_acknowledg: I understand the earlier result is still unknown. Start a new password change.
auth_security_password_return_new_attemp: This is a new password change. It does not retry or resolve the earlier one.
auth_security_password_consequences: If this replaces an existing password, you are signed out of all sessions, including this one. If the account has no password yet, adding one keeps existing sessions signed in. If you are signed out, sign in with the new password. If that fails, recover access.
auth_security_password_failed: The password could not be changed. Please try again later.
auth_security_password_paused: The next step was not sent. This page still has the original request and the progress already confirmed.
auth_security_password_recovery_handoff: If this session ends, sign in with the new password. If sign-in fails, recover access to your account.
auth_security_password_refused: This step was refused and was not applied. No password change was confirmed. Check this page before you start a new review.
auth_security_password_review_invalidate: This review is out of date. Review the password change again before submitting it.
auth_security_password_retry_expired: This confirmation has expired. A refusal now cannot show whether the password already changed. Sign in with the new password, or recover access.
auth_security_password_retry_unavailable: A retry is not allowed right now. The original request is kept on this page and will not be sent until a retry is allowed.
auth_security_password_stage_unknown: This step is unconfirmed. The same request is kept on this page. Retry only this step while it is still allowed. No password change is confirmed yet.
auth_security_readback_unavailable: Your security settings could not be verified. The result of the action is still unknown. Try checking again.
auth_security_sessions_failed: Your sessions could not be loaded. Please try again later.
auth_security_sign_in_required: You are signed out. Sign in to manage your security settings.
auth_security_target_absent: The selected item is not in your security settings.
auth_security_target_present: The selected item is still in your security settings. You can check again or try again.
auth_signup_already_signed_in: You are already signed in. Continue to the page you came from, or sign in with a different account.
auth_signup_conflict: We could not create this account. Sign in or recover access.
auth_signup_created: Your account was created. Sign in to continue.
auth_signup_departure_description: Your entered details will be cleared. Leaving cannot undo an account creation already submitted.
auth_signup_denied: Check the handle, email, password and verification, then try again.
auth_signup_email_requirement: Use an email address up to {maximum} characters.
auth_signup_handle_correction_body: This handle was refused, and no account was created. Choose a different valid handle to start again.
auth_signup_handle_invalid: Use 3 to 64 characters: letters a–z, numbers, hyphens or underscores. Start and end with a letter or number.
auth_signup_handle_requirement: Use {minimum} to {maximum} characters: letters a–z, numbers, hyphens or underscores. Start and end with a letter or number.
auth_signup_handle_unavailable: That handle is taken or reserved.
auth_signup_page_unavailable: Registration is temporarily unavailable. No account details were submitted. Try again later.
auth_signup_password_invalid: Password must be between {minimum} and {maximum} characters.
auth_signup_return_checking: Checking account options. This does not retry account creation or sign you in.
auth_signup_return_created_body: Your account was created, but you were not signed in automatically. Sign in or recover access.
auth_signup_return_current_session: An account is signed in. That does not show whether the earlier registration finished or which account it created.
auth_signup_return_new_attempt: This is a new registration. Reviewing this page does not show whether the earlier account was created.
auth_signup_return_new_attempt_created: This is a new registration. The earlier account was created. This review did not confirm that you are signed in.
auth_signup_return_unavailable_body: Account options could not be loaded. The earlier result still stands. Check again, sign in, or recover access.
auth_signup_return_unknown_body: The earlier request may have created an account. The account, handle or email cannot show whether it did. Sign in or recover access, or check account options before you start again.
auth_signup_return_unknown_heading: Your earlier account creation may have completed
auth_signup_return_viewer_changed: The signed-in account changed during this review. This does not resolve the earlier registration.
auth_signup_signing_in: Your account was created. Signing in…
auth_signup_retry_refused: This retry was refused. It does not show whether the earlier attempt succeeded. Retry only the original attempt, or sign in or recover access.
auth_signup_retry_verification_failed: The new security check was refused. Your original account creation may still have completed. Retry only the original attempt, or sign in or recover access.
auth_signup_turnstile_failed: The security check could not load or has stopped. Please try again.
auth_signup_turnstile_required: Complete the security check before creating your account.
auth_signup_uncertain_body: Account creation may have completed for the handle and email shown below. Retry only this same attempt after a fresh security check. If you do not want to retry, sign in or recover access. Your password is never shown here.
auth_signup_uncertain_title: We could not confirm whether your account was created.
auth_signup_verification_failed: The security check was not accepted. This request did not create an account. Complete a new check and try again.
auth_step_up_departure_description: Leaving clears what you entered here and closes browser prompts where possible. A sign-in already sent continues in the background.
auth_step_up_explanation: Your session is not recent enough for this request, so enter your email and password to continue.
auth_step_up_continuation_changed: You were verified, but the saved action changed or was removed. Return to the action and review it again. The action was not sent.
auth_step_up_review_required: After you verify, review the pending action and confirm it again. Verifying does not send the action.
auth_step_up_account_changed: You were verified, but the required account session is no longer current. Return to the action and verify again.
auth_step_up_return_acknowledged: Sign-in was accepted. Review the current guidance before you continue.
auth_step_up_return_no_continue: This check cannot confirm that you should continue. You can start a new identity confirmation.
auth_step_up_return_refused: The last sign-in was refused. No account action was sent.
auth_step_up_return_unknown: A sign-in request may have reached Auth. Its result is unknown, and this page will not send it again.
auth_step_up_return_unsent: No sign-in was sent. You can start again when this check finishes.
auth_transfer_accepted: Destination acceptance recorded. Send this reference to the source manager with the same transfer request. Acceptance alone does not transfer the account.
auth_transfer_account_changed: This account does not match the saved transfer, or the saved transfer cannot be read. This page cannot submit it.
auth_transfer_confirm_destination: I confirm this exact account, current operator, relationship version, and destination, and I accept responsibility as destination manager.
auth_transfer_confirm_source: I confirm this exact account, current operator, relationship version, and destination, and I want to submit the transfer using the destination acceptance.
auth_transfer_conflict: The source relationship, version, or destination does not match this transfer. Nothing saved here was changed. Ask the source manager for a new request.
auth_transfer_continue_source: Continue as source manager (requires source authority)
auth_transfer_acknowledged: The source transfer was acknowledged. This does not confirm the current operator relationship.
auth_transfer_current_unavailable: The transfer was acknowledged, but the current relationship could not be read. Try again or return to management.
auth_transfer_imported_request_provenanc: The source operator, operated account, version, and proposed destination shown here came from the imported request file. The source relationship has not been checked live.
auth_transfer_native_advice_source: You can request a transfer from the current operator. This does not approve or complete the transfer.
auth_transfer_native_advice_destination: You can enter acceptance for the proposed destination. This does not approve the source or show that the transfer can complete.
auth_transfer_denied: You do not have permission for this step. The destination manager must be allowed to manage the destination. The source manager must be allowed to manage the current operator. A copied reference does not grant permission.
auth_transfer_destination_heading: Destination manager: review and accept first
auth_transfer_explanation: Send the exact transfer request to the destination manager. They must review and accept it. Then the source manager reviews that same request and submits the transfer with that acceptance. Each person must have current permission to manage their side.
auth_transfer_guide_file_formats: Use the original request JSON file or plain-text acceptance file, encoded as UTF-8.
auth_transfer_guide_orientation: Prepare a request as the current operator, or open a request file as the proposed operator.
auth_transfer_handoff_acceptance_loaded: Acceptance file loaded locally for this saved request. Review and confirm before submitting. REZICS will check that it matches this exact request and that you still have permission.
auth_transfer_handoff_consequences: Check all three account IDs yourself. Accepting records the proposed operator's agreement to take responsibility. Submitting asks REZICS to transfer management after checking both sides' current permissions. The transfer ends existing sessions and approvals for the old relationship and does not copy operator permissions. Checking the current relationship does not confirm that responsibility was released.
auth_transfer_handoff_download_failed: The file could not be downloaded. Try the download again or use the technical details.
auth_transfer_handoff_downloaded: Download requested. Send the file through a channel you trust; downloading does not approve or complete the transfer.
auth_transfer_handoff_explanation: Transfer management of an automated account from its current operator to a proposed operator. An operator is the person or organization responsible for that account.
auth_transfer_handoff_file_help: Select one local file of at most 4096 bytes. A file only carries a request or response. It does not verify identity, the account, or permission. Selecting or downloading a file does not approve or submit.
auth_transfer_handoff_import_response: Select the acceptance file returned by the proposed operator. It applies only to this saved request.
auth_transfer_handoff_invalid_acceptance: This is not a valid acceptance response. Select the original plain-text acceptance file, without editing it.
auth_transfer_handoff_invalid_request: This is not a valid transfer request. Select the original request file, without editing it.
auth_transfer_handoff_one_file: Select one file only. The saved request is unchanged.
auth_transfer_handoff_preserved: The saved request, response, and operation key are kept. A submitted, accepted, or uncertain attempt cannot be replaced here. Continue with the same request.
auth_transfer_handoff_request_loaded: Request file loaded locally. Choose Review to check the current relationship; no acceptance has been given.
auth_transfer_handoff_send_heading: Current operator: send request and submit response
auth_transfer_handoff_send_request: Send this request file to the proposed operator. Keep this page’s saved request for their response.
auth_transfer_handoff_step_accept: Proposed operator: select the request file, review its source details as information from the file, then confirm acceptance. Download the acceptance file and send it back.
auth_transfer_handoff_step_readback: View the current relationship yourself. Acceptance alone does not complete a transfer or release responsibility.
auth_transfer_handoff_step_request: Current operator: prepare a request, download it and send the file to the proposed operator through a channel you trust.
auth_transfer_handoff_step_submit: Current operator: return to this saved request, select the acceptance file, review the account IDs, then confirm and submit the transfer.
auth_transfer_handoff_too_large: This file exceeds 4096 bytes. The saved request is unchanged.
auth_transfer_handoff_unreadable: This file could not be read as UTF-8 text. The saved request is unchanged.
auth_transfer_invalid: Use the original transfer request and acceptance reference. Do not add or change fields. Invalid destinations cannot be submitted.
auth_transfer_observed: The current relationship shows the destination operator. This does not confirm that responsibility cleanup is finished.
auth_transfer_prepare: View current relationship and prepare request
auth_transfer_reconfirm: The saved account, request, operation key, and references are kept. Review them and confirm again. Returning does not submit the transfer.
auth_transfer_recovery_acknowledged: The source transfer was acknowledged. That stays the outcome even if the current state cannot be read.
auth_transfer_recovery_authority: Permission information is unavailable. Private transfer details and actions are hidden. This does not cancel or resolve the saved transfer.
auth_transfer_recovery_destination: The destination accepted this transfer. That acceptance does not complete or confirm the source transfer.
auth_transfer_recovery_observed: This only shows the current relationship. It does not show that the earlier transfer caused it.
auth_transfer_recovery_pending: Checking current transfer information. Earlier results stay separate.
auth_transfer_recovery_readback_changed: The current relationship differs from the expected result. The acknowledgement remains, but this does not prove the transfer failed.
auth_transfer_recovery_saved: A saved transfer step needs to be reviewed again. No transfer result is known.
auth_transfer_recovery_source_unknown: The source transfer may have been sent, but its outcome is unknown. A matching relationship does not prove this transfer completed.
auth_transfer_recovery_unavailable: Current transfer information is unavailable. The relationship and permission are not shown.
auth_transfer_recovery_unreadable: The saved transfer details cannot be reviewed. They remain untouched, and no replacement transfer is available.
auth_transfer_request: Transfer request (share with the destination manager)
auth_transfer_review_same_person: Review this request as destination manager
auth_transfer_step_up: Verify the same initiating account with the management profile to continue. Then review and confirm again.
auth_transfer_unavailable: Transfer review is unavailable. The relationship and permission are not shown. A submitted transfer still needs a separate view of the current relationship.
auth_transfer_uncertain: The outcome is uncertain. Keep this request, its operation key, and its references. View the current relationship or retry the same step. Release of responsibility is not confirmed.
auth_automated_history_blocked: An earlier creation is still unresolved. Only that same attempt can be continued.
auth_automated_history_dismissed: The displayed history was dismissed. Any unresolved creation and its recovery record remain unchanged.
auth_automated_history_interrupted: The creation review was interrupted before anything was sent.
auth_automated_history_unknown: A creation may have been sent. Its result is still unknown.
auth_automated_intro: Create an actor publicly marked with its operator. Enter the exact operator account ID and a new handle. This does not create a sign-in for the actor.
auth_automated_authority: The operator's permission to manage accounts is checked. Those permissions are not copied to the actor.
auth_automated_confirm_check: I confirm this exact operator and handle. Retry only this same creation if its response is lost.
auth_automated_step_up: Verify the same human with the management profile, then review and confirm creation again.
auth_automated_refused: Creation was refused. Check the requesting account and its permission to manage accounts. If an earlier response was lost, keep the same creation.
auth_automated_unknown: The result is uncertain. Review and retry the same operator, handle, and operation key. No new creation has been prepared.
auth_automated_unavailable: The operator or account management is unavailable. A signed-in management check is required to review the operator.
auth_automated_result: This is the creation result. Public identity and management status require a separate authorized check.
auth_opening_intro: Switch to an operated identity. This replaces your browser session with the selected automated actor. Your human credentials and the operator's permissions are not copied.
auth_opening_consequences: This replaces your browser session with the operated actor's session, using only that actor's permissions. Your human credentials and the operator's permissions are not copied.
auth_opening_confirm: I approve switching to this operated identity through this operator.
auth_opening_step_up: Sign in again as the same human with the opening profile, then review and confirm again.
auth_opening_refused: Opening refused. Your current identity, selected accounts or approval no longer match.
auth_opening_unavailable: The account details are unavailable. Opening is disabled.
auth_opening_unknown: The opening result is unknown. Check the current session. Another opening requires a fresh human sign-in and new confirmation.
auth_opening_restart: Sign in again for a new opening
auth_opening_return_review: A review was underway. No session opening request was sent.
auth_opening_return_approval: Still in preliminary checks or approval. No session opening was sent.
auth_opening_return_possible: A session opening request may have reached the server. Its outcome is still unknown.
auth_opening_return_unknown: The request outcome is still unknown. Checking your session cannot show which request created it.
auth_opening_return_refused: The opening was refused. This response does not resend or cancel another request.
auth_opening_readback_note: This is only the current session. It does not prove that the earlier request created it.
auth_opening_response_note: The response to this opening confirmed the session.
auth_opening_departure_uncertain: The server may continue processing this opening after you leave. Checking your session later cannot show which request created it.
auth_account_identity_checking: Checking which account is signed in.
auth_account_identity_missing: This account has no login email to display.
auth_account_identity_security_target: Security changes on this page affect {account}.
auth_transfer_departure_description: Your unsent transfer preparation and review will be discarded.
auth_security_passkeys_browser_unavailab: This browser cannot create passkeys. You can still review and remove your saved passkeys.
auth_security_inventory_truncated: Some sessions or passkeys may not be shown. Refresh the list after making changes.
auth_security_step_up_advice: Confirm your identity again to continue.
auth_security_passkey_capacity: You have reached the limit of 32 passkeys. Remove one before adding another.
auth_account_delete_authentication_requi: Sign in to review this account and whether deletion is permitted. Returning here never deletes the account.
auth_account_delete_authenticate: Sign in and return to review
auth_account_delete_advice_available: Deletion can be requested. Requirements and permission are checked again when you submit.
auth_account_delete_review_changed: Your account or session changed. Reload the review and confirm again.
auth_account_delete_submit_requirements: Submitting also checks temporary holds and unfinished work. This review does not confirm that they are clear.
auth_account_delete_retention_limits: Records that must be kept follow their retention exceptions. Backup expiry and external copies are separate, and this page cannot confirm that they are erased.
auth_organization_delete_authentication_: Sign in to review this selection. Until you do, the selected ID is unverified, and the organization, your permission, and deletion requirements are unavailable.
auth_organization_delete_advice: This review shows whether deletion is permitted now. It does not grant deletion or confirm that every requirement is met. Confirming checks your sign-in and the requirements again.
auth_security_current_consequence: This session is on this device. Signing it out signs you out here, and you need to sign in again.
auth_security_session_consequence: Signing out this session signs that device out.
auth_security_passkey_removal_rule: Removal is refused if this is your last sign-in credential.
auth_security_retry_explanation: Confirming sends a new request for this same item. Seeing it still listed does not show what the earlier request did.
auth_security_target_checking: Checking status. No removal is sent.
auth_security_target_incomplete: This item is not in this partial list, so that does not prove it is gone. Check its status again.
auth_security_session_unknown: The session sign-out result is unknown. Check its status before you try again.
auth_security_passkey_unknown: The passkey removal result is unknown. Check its status before you try again.
auth_security_session_present: This session is present. Review the guidance here before you try again.
auth_security_passkey_present: This passkey is present. Review the guidance here before you try again.
auth_security_session_absent: This session is not in the complete list. That does not show what the earlier sign-out did.
auth_security_passkey_absent: This passkey is not in the complete list. That does not show what the earlier removal did.
auth_security_target_historical: These details were shown earlier. Check status before you try again.
auth_security_target_return_unknown: A security request may have been sent, and its result is unknown. Review security status or sign in again. This page will not send it again automatically.
auth_security_target_return_acknowledged: A security request was acknowledged. The list on this page is a separate check.
auth_security_target_return_refused: A security request was refused. Removal is not confirmed.
auth_security_target_return_dismiss_help: Dismissing this notice only hides it. It does not cancel or confirm the action.
auth_account_delete_approval_pending: Checking whether this deletion request can proceed…
auth_account_delete_recovery_description: The earlier deletion request may have completed. Refreshing checks the review again and does not send a deletion. If the review allows it, confirm the same request again by typing the phrase.
auth_account_delete_recovery_precision: After you return, only a saved hint that it was submitted is available. This page cannot tell how far the deletion went.
auth_organization_delete_recovery_not_st: The review is not loaded yet. Checking now does not send a deletion.
auth_organization_delete_recovery_denied: Deletion review was denied. Private details and deletion controls are unavailable.
auth_organization_delete_recovery_hidden: This organization is hidden from you. Its deletion status is unknown.
auth_organization_delete_recovery_missin: The organization is not in this review. That does not show whether an earlier deletion completed.
auth_organization_delete_return_unsent: The earlier attempt stopped before a deletion request was sent. Review the current organization before confirming another action.
auth_organization_delete_return_acknowle: Cleanup is still pending. Records we must keep, including any remaining financial obligations, stay in place.
auth_organization_delete_return_refused: This attempt was refused. It does not change a separate request that is still unresolved.
auth_organization_delete_return_review_r: Organization details stay hidden until you review them again.
auth_organization_delete_recovery_fence: Another deletion is unavailable while this request is unresolved. Refreshing the review cannot approve it, repeat it, or resolve it.
auth_organization_delete_recovery_pendin: Loading the review. The earlier deletion outcome is still unknown.
auth_organization_delete_recovery_authen: Sign in to load the review. No private organization information is available here. Signing in does not resolve or repeat the earlier deletion.
auth_organization_delete_recovery_refuse: The organization is missing or review is currently refused. Private information and deletion controls are unavailable. This does not tell us what happened to the earlier request.
auth_organization_delete_recovery_change: The account, organization, or request changed. Private information and deletion controls are no longer available. The earlier deletion outcome is still unknown.
auth_organization_delete_recovery_unavai: The review is unavailable. A browser timeout does not cancel server work or show the earlier deletion outcome. You can check again.
auth_organization_delete_recovery_depart: If you leave, the earlier deletion outcome stays unknown. Leaving, or losing data saved in this browser, cannot cancel work already sent.
auth_security_passkey_account_changed: The account changed while that passkey result was still unresolved. This account's passkeys are not linked to that registration.
auth_security_passkey_name_help: If you leave this blank, Auth suggests a label from this browser and system. It may not identify the passkey you save.
auth_security_passkey_prompt_pending: Choose a passkey in your browser, or dismiss the prompt to cancel before anything is saved.
auth_security_passkey_registration_cance: No passkey was saved because the browser prompt was cancelled before registration was sent.
auth_security_passkey_registration_check: Checking current passkeys. This cannot confirm whether the earlier registration was saved.
auth_security_passkey_registration_confi: Auth confirmed the registration. Refreshing passkeys and permissions.
auth_security_passkey_registration_revie: You reviewed the current passkeys. This does not confirm whether the earlier registration succeeded.
auth_security_passkey_registration_savin: The browser sent the registration. The passkey may already be saved. Waiting for confirmation.
auth_security_passkey_authority_retired: The earlier passkey result is still unconfirmed, but this page can no longer check it for the previous account.
auth_route_failure_body: Try loading this page again. If you just submitted an account action, review its result on the page where you submitted it before you try that action again.
auth_route_failure_failed_body: The page could not be restored. A recent account action may still need review before you continue.
auth_route_failure_read_only: Retry loads this page again. It does not repeat an earlier action. Review any earlier action on its own page.
auth_route_failure_interrupted: Loading was interrupted when you left. Choose Retry to load this page, or use a link below.
auth_route_failure_retry_failed: The page still could not be shown after retrying.
auth_route_missing_body: This address doesn't match an Auth page. Retry checks it again, or go to Sign in or Account security.
auth_consent_history_unknown: An earlier approval result is unknown and may have taken effect. Reviewing current permissions does not resolve it.
auth_consent_history_acknowledged: An approval was acknowledged. That does not confirm which permissions are available now.
auth_consent_history_next: Review current permissions without sending a decision, or go to Security. Leaving cannot undo a submitted approval.
auth_consent_sending: Sending approval… The result has not been acknowledged.
auth_consent_departure_description: An approval may still take effect after you leave. Leaving does not cancel it or resolve an unknown result. Stay to review current permissions, or leave.
auth_rename_acknowledged: The original rename was acknowledged. The current handle could not be confirmed. Review the current account.
auth_rename_observation: The handle shown now does not confirm the outcome of the earlier rename.
auth_automated_operator_invalid: Enter a complete operator account ID (UUID).
auth_automated_responsibility: The operator will be publicly identified as responsible for this actor. Creating it does not add a sign-in for the actor or copy the operator's permissions. Changing the operator needs its own authorized action.
auth_login_return_unsent: Passkey options were still being prepared. No sign-in was sent. Choose a method using the guidance now shown.
auth_login_return_prompt: The browser was waiting for a passkey. That prompt was closed without signing in. Choose a method again when ready.
auth_login_return_acknowledged: Sign-in was acknowledged before you left this page. Review your session to decide how to continue.
auth_login_return_refused: The earlier sign-in was refused. Use the guidance shown to choose your next step.
auth_login_return_separate: The account shown now is a separate check. It cannot confirm or cancel an earlier unconfirmed sign-in.
auth_login_return_dismiss_help: Dismissing this only hides the notice. It does not resolve or cancel the earlier sign-in.
auth_login_prompt_cancelled: The passkey prompt was cancelled before sign-in was sent. Choose password or press the passkey button when ready.
auth_security_passkey_history_acknowledg: Auth confirmed this passkey registration earlier. This acknowledgement does not show whether the passkey is active now.
auth_security_passkey_history_unknown: Auth may have received this passkey registration, but the result is unknown. Check current passkeys before continuing.
auth_account_delete_return_unsent: The earlier review did not send a deletion request.
auth_account_delete_return_unknown: A deletion request may have reached the server. The result is still unknown, and this page cannot resolve it.
auth_account_delete_return_acknowledged: The deletion request was accepted. Cleanup remains pending, so complete erasure is not confirmed.
auth_home_identity_note: These private details only help you recognize the account. An email or account ID does not prove permission, a human account, or an operator.
auth_home_accounts_description: Review creating a separate account. This page does not start a request or confirm that you can create one.
auth_home_organization_description: An organization is a separate account identity with no sign-in of its own. Prepare a handle and review it carefully. Sign-in and creation checks happen on the next page.
auth_home_automated_description: Prepare the exact operator account ID and a handle. You must be signed in as a human. The next page checks that you can manage that operator before you review and confirm. This does not create a sign-in for the actor or copy the operator's permissions.
auth_home_selection_heading: Tasks that need a specific account
auth_home_selection_description: Choose the account in the directory or flow where you manage it. This page does not list accounts. A public profile or handle is not enough to manage an account, and this page cannot choose one for you.
auth_home_members_description: Start from the organization in its own flow. Review the member and the requested change there. Sign-in and permission checks still apply.
auth_home_organization_delete_descriptio: Start from the organization in its own flow. Review obligations and requirements before you confirm deletion. An uncertain result or lost access does not mean deletion or cleanup is complete.
auth_home_transfer_description: Use the actor, its current operator, and the destination from the transfer flow. The destination manager reviews and accepts the request. The source manager then reviews that same request and submits it. Each side needs current permission.
auth_home_transfer_exit: Review Security before an operator transfer
auth_home_opening_description: Use the exact automated actor and its current operator. You must be signed in as a human, and permission checks are required. Opening replaces your browser session. Your human credentials and the operator's permissions are not copied.
auth_members_return_unsent: This review ended before the change was sent. Review current membership to start again.
auth_members_return_refused: This attempt was refused. That does not resolve an earlier unknown request.
auth_members_return_boundary: This history is separate from current membership. Dismissing it only hides this text. It does not cancel work or allow a retry.
auth_transfer_return_separate: Current state is shown separately. Dismissing this summary does not cancel, retry or resolve a transfer.
auth_transfer_return_review: A transfer review was closed before it was sent. Private details prepared here were discarded.
auth_consent_history_unattributed: An earlier submission is unresolved. This page cannot identify which account submitted it.
auth_consent_history_refused: The latest approval was refused. This refusal does not resolve any earlier unknown result.
auth_consent_history_dismiss_explanation: Hiding this explanation does not cancel, confirm, or undo the decision. Any unresolved submission stays unresolved.
auth_organization_return_advice_unavaila: Session guidance could not be verified. Check it again or open Security before continuing.
auth_organization_return_advice_ready: Session guidance is available again. This check cannot restore the earlier private creation details. This page will not start another creation.
auth_organization_return_dismiss_help: Hiding this explanation does not cancel, undo, confirm, or allow any work. It does not allow another creation request.
auth_owned_description: These are applications you own. Ownership and configured capabilities do not allow an application to act as you. Review or remove consent separately under Permissions you granted.
auth_owned_copy_failed: Could not copy. You can select and copy the identifier yourself.
auth_owned_capabilities: These are the scopes listed for this application. They are not permissions you have granted or a current permission decision.
auth_owned_scopes_empty: No scopes are listed for this application.
auth_owned_disabled_note: Disabled does not mean earlier consent was removed, erasure completed or previous work was cancelled.
auth_owned_expired: This page position has expired or the session changed. Retry this page, or start again from the first page.
auth_members_previous_boundary: Previous is unavailable from the oldest page still kept. You can return to the first page.
auth_security_passkey_rename_step_up: Sign in again before renaming this passkey.
auth_security_passkey_rename_failed: The name was not changed. Review your session before trying again.
auth_security_passkey_rename_unknown: The rename was not confirmed. Check the current name before you decide what to do next.
auth_security_passkey_rename_review_fail: The current name is unavailable. The earlier rename is still unconfirmed.
auth_security_passkey_rename_observed: Current name: {name}. This does not confirm the earlier rename.
auth_security_passkey_rename_history: An earlier passkey rename may have completed. The current name does not confirm it.
